description: This Java class defines an ELResolver implementation called NodeELResolver, which resolves properties on DOM Node objects or NodeImpl objects by evaluating XPath expressions. It provides read-only property resolution, allowing XPath-based querying of XML nodes within a EL (Expression Language) context in a Java-based project.

classes.name: NodeELResolver
classes.description: A custom ELResolver for resolving properties on DOM Nodes using XPath expressions, primarily for read-only evaluation within EL contexts.

methods.name: getCommonPropertyType
methods.description: Returns String.class if the base object is resolvable; otherwise null.

methods.name: getFeatureDescriptors
methods.description: Returns null; not implemented in this resolver.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns Node.class if the base is resolvable, indicating the type of property this resolver handles.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Evaluates an XPath expression (given as a string property) against the Node base, returning matching nodes or lists of nodes.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Always returns true; this resolver is read-only.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Throws PropertyNotWritableException, as the resolver is read-only.
